title: Proclamation No. 731, s. 2014
text:
MALACAÑAN PALACE MANILA

PROCLAMATION NO. 731

DECLARING THURSDAY, 3 APRIL 2014, AS A SPECIAL (NON-WORKING) DAY IN THE PROVINCE OF ALBAY

WHEREAS , Thursday, 3 April 2014, marks the celebration of “Albay Day” in the Province of Albay;

WHEREAS , it is but fitting and proper that the people of the Province of Albay be given full opportunity to celebrate and participate in the occasion with appropriate ceremonies.

NOW, THEREFORE, I, PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. , Executive Secretary, by authority of His Excellency, BENIGNO S. AQUINO III , do hereby declare Thursday, 3 April 2014, as a special (non-working) day in the Province of Albay.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF , I have hereunto set my hand and caused the seal of the Republic of the Philippines to be affixed.

Done in the City of Manila, this 7th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand and Fourteen.

By authority of the President:

(Sgd.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA JR. Executive Secretary
